scope: Public-source realization ledger for Poland's May 2024 JASSM-ER order; comparator rows are explicitly not direct case events.

events.actor: United States Department of State / Congress notification
events.object: Possible sale of AGM-158B-2 JASSM-ER and related support
events.boundary: A possible-sale authorization is not a signed order, production record, delivery, acceptance, or operational availability.

events.actor: Polish Ministry of National Defence / United States government
events.source_locator: Polish MOD JASSM-ER page, agreement announcement
events.boundary: The public announcement does not state the purchased quantity, acceptance, shipment, fielding, training, inventory change, or operational use.

events.actor: United States Department of State / Congress notification
events.object: Enhancement or upgrade in sensitivity of technology/capability related to original JASSM-ER possible-sale case 24-33
events.quantity_unit: possible missiles ceiling repeated from original notification
events.boundary: The notification does not establish a signed order modification, changed quantity, shipment, acceptance, fielding, training, inventory, operational use, or geopolitical response.

events.actor: Polish Ministry of National Defence / United States government
events.source_locator: Polish MOD JASSM-ER page, delivery-window statement
events.boundary: A planned window is not evidence that any shipment or delivery occurred.

events.object: JASSM-family missile delivery schedule described in a modernization briefing
events.boundary: The briefing gives a 2028-2030 planning window and attributes it to supply-chain alignment with expanded-fleet operational readiness; it does not establish a contract amendment, delay, shipment, acceptance, fielding, training, or operational availability for the May 2024 order.

The audit documents missing numeric support and unreliable advance recording in the cited settlement context; it does not establish production, delay, non-delivery, acceptance, or fielding for the 2024 order.

events.object: 2024 JASSM-ER order shipment, acceptance, Polish unit receipt, training, inventory, and operational-use evidence
events.source_locator: Reviewed Polish MOD, US DSCA/DoD, NIK, and related official-source records listed in ai-work-control-081 through -083
events.boundary: This bounded public-source non-observation is not proof that no delivery occurred. It only prevents promotion to realized operational capability on the reviewed evidence.

events.actor: Polish Ministry of National Defence / Polish Senate response
events.object: JASSM-ER listed among equipment delivered since February 24, 2022
events.boundary: The response confirms only that JASSM-ER appears in a broad delivered-equipment list; it gives no quantity, date, customer unit, acceptance record, or linkage to the May 2024 order. It is baseline/comparator evidence, not current-order realization evidence.

events.source_locator: Polish MOD announcement, Nowoczesne pociski dalekiego zasięgu JASSM-ER dla Wojska Polskiego
events.boundary: The announcement is a planned first-delivery milestone, not a shipment, receiving-unit, acceptance, training, inventory, or operational-use record.

events.object: First reported delivery of JASSM missiles; separate 2016 JASSM-ER procurement baseline
events.source_locator: Polish MOD page, Pociski JASSM dla F-16, 20 January 2017
events.boundary: The page reports first JASSM delivery to the F-16 base and separately describes the JASSM-ER agreement; it does not establish quantity or realization of the May 2024 JASSM-ER order. It is historical family/platform context, not current-order shipment, acceptance, or geopolitical leverage evidence.

events.object: Four F-35 aircraft in a separate agreement
events.source_locator: NIK 2024 FMS realization audit, pp. 12–13, lines 603–621
events.boundary: The comparator shows that schedule, physical delivery, and settlement can occur on different clocks; it is not evidence about the JASSM-ER order.

events.actor: Polish Armed Forces / Lockheed Martin F-35 program
events.object: First three Polish F-35 aircraft arrived in Poland
events.source_locator: Polish National Security Bureau ceremony record, lines 67–70
events.boundary: This is a separate F-35 comparator. Arrival does not by itself establish formal acceptance, training completion, combat readiness, or operational effect for the JASSM-ER order.

events.actor: Polish National Security Bureau / Polish Armed Forces
events.object: Ceremonial official acceptance of F-35 aircraft into Polish Armed Forces equipment
events.source_locator: Polish National Security Bureau ceremony record, lines 45–49 and 67
events.boundary: This comparator demonstrates a public acceptance milestone for a separate platform; it does not establish training completion, full operational availability, geopolitical leverage, or any JASSM-ER order stage.

boundary: This ledger separates direct case evidence, bounded non-observation, and comparator evidence. It is not a readiness score, delivery estimate, inventory count, or geopolitical-leverage measure.
